name: Equation-based Constraint Masking
description: Replaced the explicit "cannot both be 1, cannot both be 2" conditions with the mathematically equivalent nonlinear equation $r_u^3 + r_v^3 = 9$ over the domain $\{1, 2\}$. This prevents LLMs from pattern-matching standard bipartite coloring or 2-SAT descriptions, forcing them to algebraically deduce that adjacent nodes must have different values.
